operation: Minimum squared Euclidean distance between closed native line/arc segments, and from an exact point to one segment.
domain: Existing exact Real Point2, LineSeg2 and CircularArc2 carriers; unchecked zero-length line segments are treated as singleton points. General Bezier/NURBS and filled-region boundary extraction are outside this primitive API.
output: ExactCurveResult<Real>; operation Evaluation. Existing evaluate_under / evaluate_with_budget retain the selected policy and certainty receipt.
witness: A minimum over exact intersection, endpoint-to-segment, and interior stationary candidates. A point/arc interior minimum is radial; a line/arc interior pair lies on a circle normal perpendicular to the line; two nonconcentric arcs have interior stationary points on their center line. Concentric arcs need endpoint/radial candidates only. Every finite-domain and ordering decision uses the active curve policy.
identity: Input segments remain untouched. The returned scalar is a measurement; no reconstructed boundary or chord is promoted to topology.
failure: Invalid scalar operations or invariant failures return ExactCurveError::Invalid; undecided predicates and active work exhaustion return ExactCurveError::Blocked. An unknown candidate is never dropped from the minimum.
budget: A constant-size native candidate set, with existing shared work accounting in dependent predicates/intersections and explicit propagation of prior exhaustion. This is not a bound on scalar precision, coefficient growth, bytes, or elapsed time.
validation_plan: Independent rational and radical distance oracles across line/line, line/arc, arc/arc and point pairs.
Crossing, tangency, overlap, concentric and disjoint sweeps, degenerate lines, reversal, swapped operands and exact tiny separation.
Both predicate policies and exhausted-budget retry without negative result caching.
Focused debug/release tests, existing segment/intersection consumers, strict Clippy/docs/fmt, a reproducible native-distance performance probe with scope and resource limitations stated.
dependent_work: DRC must retain authored geometry and use this native metric with authoritative bounds and typed uncertainty. The existing failing via probe stays open until those consumers are repaired.
status: native primitive API implemented and validated; DRC source and consumer integration remains open
